nodes.name: 📥 Webhook Trigger
nodes.notes:
EN: Webhook endpoint to receive event data. POST JSON with event details.
DE: Webhook-Endpunkt zum Empfangen von Event-Daten. POST JSON mit Event-Details.

Expected Input Format / Erwartetes Eingabeformat:
{
  "eventTitle": "DJ Night @ Club XYZ",
  "eventDate": "2025-05-15",
  "eventTime": "22:00",
  "venue": "Club XYZ",
  "city": "Berlin",
  "description": "Amazing DJ night with...",
  "imageUrl": "https://example.com/image.jpg",
  "ticketUrl": "https://tickets.example.com",
  "publishTo": {
    "twitter": true,
    "instagram": true,
    "facebook": true,
    "linkedin": false,
    "reddit": true,
    "email": true
  },
  "emailRecipients": ["fan1@example.com", "fan2@example.com"],
  "redditSubreddit": "DJs",
  "redditFlair": "Event",
  "redditNsfw": false,
  "redditSpoiler": false
}

nodes.name: ✅ Webhook Response
nodes.notes:
EN: Sends response back to webhook caller.
DE: Sendet Antwort zurück an Webhook-Aufrufer.

nodes.name: 🔍 Validate & Prepare Data
nodes.notes:
EN: Validates required fields and prepares data for posting.
DE: Validiert Pflichtfelder und bereitet Daten für das Posting vor.

Required Fields / Pflichtfelder:
- eventTitle: Event name
- eventDate: Date in YYYY-MM-DD format
- venue: Venue name
- city: City name

Optional Fields / Optionale Felder:
- eventTime: Time (HH:MM)
- description: Event description
- imageUrl: URL to event image
- ticketUrl: URL to tickets
- publishTo: Object with boolean flags for each platform
- emailRecipients: Array of email addresses
- redditSubreddit: Subreddit name (required if reddit enabled)
- redditFlair: Flair text for Reddit post
- redditNsfw: NSFW flag (true/false)
- redditSpoiler: Spoiler flag (true/false)
- redditPostType: 'self' (text) or 'link'

nodes.name: ✏️ Format Content for Platforms
nodes.notes:
EN: Formats event content optimized for each platform:
- Twitter/X: Max 280 characters
- Instagram: Up to 2200 characters, includes hashtags
- Facebook: Standard format
- LinkedIn: Professional tone
- Reddit: Markdown format with headers and formatting
- Email: HTML and plain text versions

DE: Formatiert Event-Content optimiert für jede Plattform:
- Twitter/X: Max. 280 Zeichen
- Instagram: Bis zu 2200 Zeichen, inkl. Hashtags
- Facebook: Standard-Format
- LinkedIn: Professioneller Ton
- Reddit: Markdown-Format mit Überschriften und Formatierung
- E-Mail: HTML und Plain-Text Versionen

nodes.name: 🐦 Post to Twitter/X?
nodes.notes:
EN: Checks if Twitter/X posting is enabled.
DE: Prüft, ob Twitter/X Posting aktiviert ist.

Configure in publishTo.twitter field.
In publishTo.twitter Feld konfigurieren.

nodes.name: 🐦 Post to Twitter/X
nodes.notes:
EN: Posts to Twitter/X.

CREDENTIALS REQUIRED / CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH:
- Twitter OAuth1 API credentials
- Get from: https://developer.twitter.com/
- Create App → API Keys & Tokens
- Need: API Key, API Secret, Access Token, Access Token Secret

DE: Postet auf Twitter/X.

CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH:
- Twitter OAuth1 API Credentials
- Von: https://developer.twitter.com/
- App erstellen → API Keys & Tokens
- Benötigt: API Key, API Secret, Access Token, Access Token Secret

nodes.name: 📷 Post to Instagram?
nodes.notes:
EN: Checks if Instagram posting is enabled.
DE: Prüft, ob Instagram Posting aktiviert ist.

Configure in publishTo.instagram field.
In publishTo.instagram Feld konfigurieren.

NOTE: Instagram API requires Facebook Business Account and Meta App.
HINWEIS: Instagram API benötigt Facebook Business Account und Meta App.

nodes.name: 📷 Post to Instagram
nodes.notes:
EN: Posts image to Instagram.

CREDENTIALS REQUIRED / CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH:
- Instagram OAuth2 API (via Facebook Graph API)
- Requires Facebook Business Account
- Create Meta App: https://developers.facebook.com/
- App Type: Business
- Add Instagram Basic Display or Instagram Graph API product
- Need: App ID, App Secret, Access Token
- User must grant permissions

DE: Postet Bild auf Instagram.

CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH:
- Instagram OAuth2 API (über Facebook Graph API)
- Benötigt Facebook Business Account
- Meta App erstellen: https://developers.facebook.com/
- App-Typ: Business
- Instagram Basic Display oder Instagram Graph API Produkt hinzufügen
- Benötigt: App ID, App Secret, Access Token
- Benutzer muss Berechtigungen erteilen

nodes.name: 👤 Post to Facebook?
nodes.notes:
EN: Checks if Facebook posting is enabled.
DE: Prüft, ob Facebook Posting aktiviert ist.

Configure in publishTo.facebook field.
In publishTo.facebook Feld konfigurieren.

nodes.name: 👤 Post to Facebook Page
nodes.notes:
EN: Posts to Facebook Page.

CREDENTIALS REQUIRED / CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH:
- Facebook OAuth2 API
- Create Meta App: https://developers.facebook.com/
- App Type: Business
- Add Facebook Login product
- Need: App ID, App Secret, Access Token
- Page Access Token (with pages_manage_posts permission)
- Set FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID environment variable

DE: Postet auf Facebook-Seite.

CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH:
- Facebook OAuth2 API
- Meta App erstellen: https://developers.facebook.com/
- App-Typ: Business
- Facebook Login Produkt hinzufügen
- Benötigt: App ID, App Secret, Access Token
- Seiten-Access-Token (mit pages_manage_posts Berechtigung)
- FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID Umgebungsvariable setzen

nodes.name: 💼 Post to LinkedIn?
nodes.notes:
EN: Checks if LinkedIn posting is enabled.
DE: Prüft, ob LinkedIn Posting aktiviert ist.

Configure in publishTo.linkedin field.
In publishTo.linkedin Feld konfigurieren.

nodes.name: 💼 Post to LinkedIn
nodes.notes:
EN: Posts to LinkedIn.

CREDENTIALS REQUIRED / CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH:
- LinkedIn OAuth2 API
- Create LinkedIn App: https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps
- Need: Client ID, Client Secret
- OAuth Redirect URL (e.g., https://your-n8n-instance.com/rest/oauth2-credential/callback)
- Request permissions: w_member_social, w_organization_social
- Generate Access Token

DE: Postet auf LinkedIn.

CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH:
- LinkedIn OAuth2 API
- LinkedIn App erstellen: https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps
- Benötigt: Client ID, Client Secret
- OAuth Redirect URL (z.B. https://deine-n8n-instanz.com/rest/oauth2-credential/callback)
- Berechtigungen anfordern: w_member_social, w_organization_social
- Access Token generieren

nodes.name: 📧 Send Email?
nodes.notes:
EN: Checks if email sending is enabled and recipients are provided.
DE: Prüft, ob E-Mail-Versand aktiviert ist und Empfänger vorhanden sind.

Configure in publishTo.email field and provide emailRecipients array.
In publishTo.email Feld konfigurieren und emailRecipients Array bereitstellen.

nodes.name: 📧 Send Email
nodes.notes:
EN: Sends email to recipients.

CREDENTIALS REQUIRED / CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH:
- SMTP credentials
- Options:
  * Gmail: Use Gmail OAuth2 or App Password
  * Outlook: Use Office 365 SMTP
  * Custom SMTP: Host, Port, User, Password
- Set EMAIL_FROM environment variable (optional)

SMTP Settings Example / SMTP Einstellungen Beispiel:
- Host: smtp.gmail.com
- Port: 587 (TLS) or 465 (SSL)
- User: your-email@gmail.com
- Password: App Password (for Gmail)

DE: Sendet E-Mail an Empfänger.

CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH:
- SMTP Credentials
- Optionen:
  * Gmail: Gmail OAuth2 oder App-Passwort verwenden
  * Outlook: Office 365 SMTP verwenden
  * Custom SMTP: Host, Port, Benutzer, Passwort
- EMAIL_FROM Umgebungsvariable setzen (optional)

nodes.name: 🔴 Post to Reddit?
nodes.notes:
EN: Checks if Reddit posting is enabled and subreddit is provided.
DE: Prüft, ob Reddit Posting aktiviert ist und Subreddit angegeben ist.

Configure in publishTo.reddit field and provide redditSubreddit.
In publishTo.reddit Feld konfigurieren und redditSubreddit angeben.

Required for Reddit / Erforderlich für Reddit:
- redditSubreddit: Subreddit name (e.g., 'DJs', 'Techno', 'berlin')
- Optional: redditFlair, redditNsfw, redditSpoiler, redditPostType

nodes.name: 🔴 Post to Reddit
nodes.notes:
EN: Posts to Reddit using Reddit API.

CREDENTIALS REQUIRED / CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH:
- Reddit OAuth2 Token (HTTP Header Auth)
- Create Reddit App: https://www.reddit.com/prefs/apps
- App Type: 'script'
- Need: Client ID, Client Secret
- Get OAuth Token: https://github.com/reddit-archive/reddit/wiki/OAuth2
- Token format: 'Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN'
- Set REDDIT_USER_AGENT environment variable (optional)

Reddit-Specific Fields / Reddit-spezifische Felder:
- redditSubreddit: Subreddit name (required / erforderlich)
- redditFlair: Flair text (optional / optional)
- redditNsfw: NSFW flag (true/false)
- redditSpoiler: Spoiler flag (true/false)
- redditPostType: 'self' (text) or 'link' (default: 'self')

DE: Postet auf Reddit über Reddit API.

CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH:
- Reddit OAuth2 Token (HTTP Header Auth)
- Reddit App erstellen: https://www.reddit.com/prefs/apps
- App-Typ: 'script'
- Benötigt: Client ID, Client Secret
- OAuth Token holen: https://github.com/reddit-archive/reddit/wiki/OAuth2
- Token-Format: 'Bearer DEIN_ACCESS_TOKEN'
- REDDIT_USER_AGENT Umgebungsvariable setzen (optional)

nodes.name: 📊 Collect Results
nodes.notes:
EN: Collects and summarizes results from all posting operations.
DE: Sammelt und fasst Ergebnisse aller Posting-Operationen zusammen.

nodes.name: 🔀 Merge Results
nodes.notes:
EN: Merges all posting results into final output.
DE: Führt alle Posting-Ergebnisse in finale Ausgabe zusammen.

parameters.content:
# 🚀 Multi-Platform Social Media & Email Publisher

**EN:** This workflow publishes DJ events (or any events) to multiple social media platforms and sends emails simultaneously.

**DE:** Dieser Workflow veröffentlicht DJ-Events (oder beliebige Events) auf mehreren Social-Media-Plattformen und sendet gleichzeitig E-Mails.

## 📋 Supported Platforms / Unterstützte Plattformen

- 🐦 **Twitter/X** - Text + Images
- 📷 **Instagram** - Images + Captions
- 👤 **Facebook** - Posts + Images
- 💼 **LinkedIn** - Professional Posts
- 🔴 **Reddit** - Subreddit Posts with Flairs
- 📧 **Email** - HTML + Plain Text

## ⚙️ How to Use / Verwendung

1. **Configure Credentials** - See panels below for each platform
2. **Send POST request** to webhook with event data
3. **Enable/Disable platforms** via `publishTo` object

## 📝 Input Format

See "📥 Input Format" panel below for complete example.

---

*(Doppelklick zum Bearbeiten | [n8n Sticky Notes Guide](https://docs.n8n.io/workflows/sticky-notes/))*

# 📥 Input Format / Eingabeformat

## Required Fields / Pflichtfelder

```json
{
  "eventTitle": "DJ Night @ Club XYZ",
  "eventDate": "2025-05-15",
  "venue": "Club XYZ",
  "city": "Berlin"
}
```

## Complete Example / Vollständiges Beispiel

```json
{
  "eventTitle": "Techno Night @ Berghain",
  "eventDate": "2025-05-15",
  "eventTime": "23:00",
  "venue": "Berghain",
  "city": "Berlin",
  "description": "Join us for an unforgettable night!",
  "imageUrl": "https://example.com/image.jpg",
  "ticketUrl": "https://tickets.example.com",
  "publishTo": {
    "twitter": true,
    "instagram": true,
    "facebook": true,
    "linkedin": false,
    "reddit": true,
    "email": true
  },
  "emailRecipients": ["fan@example.com"],
  "redditSubreddit": "DJs",
  "redditFlair": "Event",
  "redditNsfw": false,
  "redditSpoiler": false
}
```

---

*(Doppelklick zum Bearbeiten)*

# 🔐 Credentials Setup / Credentials einrichten

## ⚠️ WICHTIG: Separate Credentials!

**Jede Plattform benötigt EIGENE Credentials!**

## Checklist / Checkliste

- [ ] **Twitter/X**: `TWITTER_CREDENTIALS_ID`
- [ ] **Instagram**: `INSTAGRAM_CREDENTIALS_ID`
- [ ] **Facebook**: `FACEBOOK_CREDENTIALS_ID`
- [ ] **LinkedIn**: `LINKEDIN_CREDENTIALS_ID`
- [ ] **Reddit**: `REDDIT_CREDENTIALS_ID`
- [ ] **Email**: `SMTP_CREDENTIALS_ID`

## 📚 Detailed Instructions

See individual credential panels below for each platform.

Siehe einzelne Credential-Panels unten für jede Plattform.

---

*(Doppelklick zum Bearbeiten)*

# 🐦 Twitter/X Credentials

## CREDENTIALS REQUIRED / CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH

1. Go to: **https://developer.twitter.com/**
2. Create App → **API Keys & Tokens**
3. You need:
   - **API Key** (Consumer Key)
   - **API Secret** (Consumer Secret)
   - **Access Token**
   - **Access Token Secret**

## In n8n:

1. **Settings** → **Credentials** → **Add Credential**
2. Select **Twitter OAuth1 API**
3. Enter all 4 values
4. Assign to node: **🐦 Post to Twitter/X**

---

**Credential ID:** `TWITTER_CREDENTIALS_ID`

*(Doppelklick zum Bearbeiten)*

# 📷 Instagram Credentials

## CREDENTIALS REQUIRED / CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH

⚠️ **Requires Facebook Business Account**

1. Go to: **https://developers.facebook.com/**
2. Create **Meta App** (Type: **Business**)
3. Add **Instagram Graph API** product
4. You need:
   - **App ID**
   - **App Secret**
   - **Access Token** (with permissions)

## In n8n:

1. **Settings** → **Credentials** → **Add Credential**
2. Select **Instagram OAuth2 API**
3. Enter credentials
4. Assign to node: **📷 Post to Instagram**

---

**Credential ID:** `INSTAGRAM_CREDENTIALS_ID`

*(Doppelklick zum Bearbeiten)*

# 👤 Facebook Credentials

## CREDENTIALS REQUIRED / CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH

1. Go to: **https://developers.facebook.com/**
2. Create **Meta App** (Type: **Business**)
3. Add **Facebook Login** product
4. You need:
   - **App ID**
   - **App Secret**
   - **Page Access Token** (with `pages_manage_posts`)
   - **Page ID** (set as env var `FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID`)

## In n8n:

1. **Settings** → **Credentials** → **Add Credential**
2. Select **Facebook OAuth2 API**
3. Enter credentials
4. Set env var: `FACEBOOK_PAGE_ID=your_page_id`
5. Assign to node: **👤 Post to Facebook Page**

---

**Credential ID:** `FACEBOOK_CREDENTIALS_ID`

*(Doppelklick zum Bearbeiten)*

# 💼 LinkedIn Credentials

## CREDENTIALS REQUIRED / CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH

1. Go to: **https://www.linkedin.com/developers/apps**
2. Create new app
3. You need:
   - **Client ID**
   - **Client Secret**
4. Configure **OAuth Redirect URL**:
   `https://your-n8n-instance.com/rest/oauth2-credential/callback`
5. Request permissions: `w_member_social`, `w_organization_social`

## In n8n:

1. **Settings** → **Credentials** → **Add Credential**
2. Select **LinkedIn OAuth2 API**
3. Enter Client ID and Secret
4. Complete OAuth flow
5. Assign to node: **💼 Post to LinkedIn**

---

**Credential ID:** `LINKEDIN_CREDENTIALS_ID`

*(Doppelklick zum Bearbeiten)*

# 🔴 Reddit Credentials

## CREDENTIALS REQUIRED / CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH

1. Go to: **https://www.reddit.com/prefs/apps**
2. Click **"create app"**
3. Fill in:
   - **Name**: Your app name
   - **App type**: **"script"**
   - **Redirect URI**: `http://localhost:8080`
4. Note:
   - **Client ID** (under app name)
   - **Client Secret** (only shown once!)
5. Get OAuth Token:
   - Use: https://not-an-aardvark.github.io/reddit-oauth-helper/
   - Token format: `Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN`

## In n8n:

1. **Settings** → **Credentials** → **Add Credential**
2. Select **HTTP Header Auth**
3. Configure:
   - **Name**: `Authorization`
   - **Value**: `Bearer YOUR_ACCESS_TOKEN`
4. Assign to node: **🔴 Post to Reddit**

---

**Credential ID:** `REDDIT_CREDENTIALS_ID`

**Reddit Fields:**
- `redditSubreddit`: Required (e.g., "DJs")
- `redditFlair`: Optional
- `redditNsfw`: true/false
- `redditSpoiler`: true/false

*(Doppelklick zum Bearbeiten)*

# 📧 Email (SMTP) Credentials

## CREDENTIALS REQUIRED / CREDENTIALS ERFORDERLICH

### Gmail:
1. Enable **2-Factor Authentication**
2. Go to: **https://myaccount.google.com/apppasswords**
3. Generate **App Password** for "Mail"
4. Use this password (not your regular password)

### SMTP Settings:
- **Host**: `smtp.gmail.com`
- **Port**: `587` (TLS) or `465` (SSL)
- **User**: your-email@gmail.com
- **Password**: App Password (for Gmail)

## In n8n:

1. **Settings** → **Credentials** → **Add Credential**
2. Select **SMTP**
3. Enter SMTP settings
4. Optional: Set `EMAIL_FROM` env var
5. Assign to node: **📧 Send Email**

---

**Credential ID:** `SMTP_CREDENTIALS_ID`

**Other Providers:**
- Outlook: `smtp.office365.com`
- Custom: Use your provider's SMTP settings

*(Doppelklick zum Bearbeiten)*
